pages.title: Air Scrubber
pages.text: The Air Scrubber actively cleans the air around it. It removes CO2, toxins, and microplastics in a 4-block radius every second, as long as it has power. It uses $(bold)40 FE every 20 ticks$().

pages.title: Placement Tips
pages.text: Place Air Scrubbers near your furnaces and in enclosed rooms. Connect them to a Power Bank so they keep working. The more scrubbers you have, the faster the air cleans up. Use the Environmental Monitor to check if your scrubbers are working!
One scrubber can clean a small room. Use several for larger spaces.
